```yaml
name: TypeScript Audit

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Enable corepack
        run: corepack enable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm run lint

      - name: Test
        run: pnpm run test

      - name: Run docs preview
        run: pnpm run preview &
        env:
          PORT: 3000

      - name: Wait for preview to start
        run: sleep 10

      - name: Verify header is hidden in docs
        run: |
          DOCS_URL="http://localhost:3000/api-docs"
          echo "Fetching docs from $DOCS_URL"
          if curl -s $DOCS_URL | grep -q "x-session-access-key"; then
            echo "❌ Header 'x-session-access-key' found in docs!"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ Header 'x-session-access-key' is not present in docs."
          fi
```
